evidence.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro

summary: OpenAI has released GPT‑5.6, now accessible via the Kiro platform, offering developers increased performance at reduced cost. The upgrade is designed to improve the price‑performance ratio, making advanced language capabilities more affordable for application integration.
title: OpenAI launches GPT‑5.6 on Kiro, delivering higher price‑performance for developers
